tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find statistical datasets in the catalog (Eurostat, World Bank, OECD, etc.). Index-backed hybrid search (name/code + embeddings). Optional country and source_name filters. Use this instead of SELECT … FROM main ILIKE. Returns compact cards, not series values.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Alias of search_catalog. Find statistical datasets by query, optional country and source_name.

tools.name: inspect_dataset
tools.description: Peek one dataset by main.id: default slice, whether a country is in the series, dataId, and the last few values. Uses indexed main_id lookup — do not scan the data table yourself for discovery.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Get one dataset metadata row from main by id (includes dimensions, default_view, geos).

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Run a read-only SELECT (or WITH … SELECT) against tables main and data only. Use after search_catalog + inspect_dataset to pull the time series for a known data.id / main_id.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List Monitly plans (Essential, Pro, Enterprise) with prices and limits.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Current plan of the key owner: name, status, period end and limits (API/day, MCP/month, watchlist, API keys).

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: MCP queries this billing period, REST API requests today and watchlist slots — used, limit, remaining.

tools.name: upgrade_plan
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for the Pro plan and return checkout_url. Open it in the browser for the user to pay.

tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.description: Datasets the user follows (watchlist) with source, latest period and alert status. Paginate with limit/offset.

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.description: Follow a dataset by id (from search_catalog). The user gets alerts when it updates. Respects the plan's watchlist limit.

tools.name: add_watchlist_batch
tools.description: Follow up to 100 datasets in one call. Skips duplicates and stops at the plan limit (reported in skipped_limit).

tools.name: remove_from_watchlist
tools.description: Unfollow a dataset by id.

tools.name: set_notification_preferences
tools.description: action='get' returns e-mail/Slack alert settings. action='set' changes email_notifications / slack_notifications, or turns alerts for one followed dataset on/off (dataset_id + dataset_notifications).

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: Active REST API keys (mon_…) of the account: id, name, prefix, created/last used.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a REST API key (mon_…) for /api endpoints. The raw key is returned once. Limit: 3 (Essential) / 10 (Pro).

tools.name: delete_api_key
tools.description: Revoke a REST API key by id. The last remaining key cannot be deleted.

tools.name: list_mcp_keys
tools.description: Active MCP keys (mcpk_…). The key used for this session is marked current=true.

tools.name: create_mcp_key
tools.description: Create another MCP key (mcpk_…), e.g. for a second client. The raw key is returned once.

tools.name: delete_mcp_key
tools.description: Revoke an MCP key by id. The key used for the current session cannot be revoked here.

tools.name: export_dataset
tools.description: Return a CSV download URL for a dataset, optionally filtered by countries and dimension values (dim1…dim8 from inspect_dataset).
